name: avatar-group
title: AvatarGroup
description: Faces stack with a +N overflow when the list grows. Team members and multi-assignee fields.
docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

configurables.what: Size applied to all children avatars.
configurables.how: s in lists; m in page headers. Keep consistent with surrounding density. Default: s.
Match Avatar shape in the same product surface. Default: circle.
3–5 in cards; higher only when space is guaranteed.

gotchas.note: Children must be Avatar components; max trims visually and should be reflected in accessible summary text (+N people).

agent.usage:
import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from '@/components/atoms/Avatar';

<AvatarGroup size="s" max={3}>
  <Avatar type="initials" initials="AL" alt="Ada" />
  <Avatar type="initials" initials="GR" alt="Grace" />
  <Avatar type="initials" initials="KT" alt="Katherine" />
  <Avatar type="initials" initials="XX" alt="Extra" />
</AvatarGroup>
